notes: PonsToken (src/PonsToken.sol) is a plain, immutable ERC-20: name Pons, symbol PONS, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 PONS (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory. totalSupply() is a constant: there is no mint, no burn, no owner, no minter role, no proxy and no upgrade path, so the supply can never grow after deployment. Every transfer moves exactly the amount requested, with no fee, tax, reflection or burn, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided pool seed through the PoolManager, claims and swaps all arrive whole; the token therefore needs no exemption list and takes none of $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber. There is no pause, blocklist, freeze, lock, seize or burnFrom, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. The token imports nothing and calls no other contract. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
